title: WaterColor "Southside Serenity" 1680 E County Hwy 30A #102
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: *Per Watercolor HOA, please include all guests aged 5 and older in your total count of adult guests to receive amenity and pool access wristbands. Sleep arrangements are provided as a courtesy and are not considered in the occupancy count.**This home is allowed 6 amenity access bands.**- Centrally located in WaterColor Town Center this Beach District Townhouse is steps away from the Beach Club and Emerald Coast- Spacious 1,703 sq ft two-story condo- 2 adult bikes provided- Washer/Dryer- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: "Southside Serenity" provides the PERFECT LOCATION in Watercolor! Located on 30A, your party will be only steps away from the beautiful Emerald Coast and the newly renovated Watercolor Beach Club. Walk through one of the picturesque Watercolor parks to the Boathouse by the lake or take a short bike ride to the incredible Camp Watercolor, which now includes a new lazy river and slide. There are plenty of restaurants and shops within walking distance, including those within Seaside. Southside Serenity is a 2-story condo that boasts stunning wooden floors in its common areas, newly updated window treatments in 2024, updated furnishings, vibrant lighting, and an open floor plan. Defining features in the second floor kitchen include granite countertops and stainless steel appliances. A convenient half-bath is also located on the second floor. Relax on the porch swing after a day at the beach on the balcony conveniently located off the living room. Enjoy ballgames or movies in the living room on the large Smart TV with soundbar and two comfortable new sofas! The second floor of the condo can also be accessed via the building's elevator.Located on the first floor, the spacious primary suite opens to a covered porch and is furnished with a charming king bed with twin sleeper chair, dresser, and Smart TV. Its ensuite bathroom has a walk-in shower, garden tub, and double vanity. The guest bedroom suite is furnished with a queen bed and two twins, Smart TV, and an ensuite bath with shower/tub combination, plus single vanity. Power outlets and charging stations are conveniently located in each of the nightstands in both bedrooms. Indeed, "Southside Serenity" understands the finer things in life so make sure that it becomes an integral part of your next stay in Watercolor! SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed & Twin Sleeper Chair, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed and Two Twins, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboSECOND FLOOR:- Living Room: Queen Sleeper, Half BathroomWATERCOLOR NEIGHBORHOOD HIGHLIGHTS: - Named the #1 family vacation destination in the U.S.- A 499-acre coastal resort and residential community- Ideal bike community perfect for family getaways- Pristine sugar sand beaches- 6 swimming pools- Pickle ball courts- Award-winning tennis facilities- Championship golf nearby- World Famous Beach Club- Unparalleled beachside, poolside, and lakeside dining- Acres of parks, gardens, and footpaths- Nearby state parks and preserves*Watercolor Community HOA prohibits the rental of Low-Speed Vehicles for guests staying in the Town Center.
